training_weather.source: ResStock embedded outdoor-air temperature (same simulation intervals)
training_weather.origin: ResStock weather constructed from NOAA ISD, NSRDB and MesoWest
training_weather.timestamp_basis: EST interval ends converted to UTC interval starts

prediction_weather.aggregation: mean of accepted observations per UTC hour; not a time-weighted integral
prediction_weather.calendar_reassignment: Same month/day/hour; 2024 temperatures assigned to 2018 timestamps

limitations: Temperature-only response; no humidity, thermal lag or equipment saturation.
Fixed population and equipment; no automatic adoption/growth trend.
Deterministic hourly schedules; not individual appliance event simulation.
